correctness.rationale: For any n-even tree n>=4, integer F(z)=det(zD-L) has derivative F_prime(0)=(-1)^(n-1)*2(n-1), by matrix-tree theorem. Rational-root theorem on F/z makes numerator p divide 2(n-1); for a reduced interior 0<p/q<2 even p would be 2 (mod 4) and reflected 2-p/q has numerator divisible by four, impossible. PST at distinct a,b forces equal degrees and eta=1 via the positive zero eigenvector. Opposite bipartition forces t=(2h+1)pi/2, and every interior supported eigenvalue would have an even reduced numerator, hence only endpoint supports; d_a=d_b=n-1 impossible. Same bipartition forces t=h pi; any negative supported rational p/q admits primitive integer generalized eigenvector qLw=pDw, leaf-stripping mod p makes every entry congruent to one unit mod p, while w_a=-w_b imposes p|2, hence p=1. Reflection of a negative eigenvalue then forces 2q-1=1, so theta=1. The resulting E1 identity makes a,b sibling leaves; endpoint+E1 projection mass 1/(n-1)+1/2<1 implies another interior positive-sign eigenvalue, whose phase would require forbidden even numerator. This proves nontransfer at all real times; n=2 P2 has PST at pi/2. The finite matching-polynomial verifier probes 34 sample even trees and 2788 rational candidates, not universal proof.

originality.rationale: Coutinho–Baptista 2022 gives spectral-sign/twin leaf necessary conditions and explicitly conjectures absence on all trees besides P2/P3, but does not establish the even-tree exclusion. Prior path results concern a strict subfamily and weighted/general Laplacian constructions use different Hamiltonians. New parity of rational normalized eigenvalues on even trees closes a full parity subcase of the published open question.

No claim for odd n>=5, pretty-good transfer, weighted trees, or arbitrary state superpositions.
